title: Replace string errors with a typed error enum in Rust
description: Brownfield Rust refactor: replace String-based error returns with a typed AppError enum. The existing parsing functions must return Result<T, AppError> instead of Result<T, String>.

required_artifacts: AppError enum has ParseInt, ParseFloat, and Validation variants
parse_score returns AppError::ParseFloat on bad parse, AppError::Validation on range
parse_username returns AppError::Validation for empty or too-long names
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test` to confirm no regressions from your refactor. Also review the code you changed — any remaining duplication, long functions, or unclear names to clean up?
Final pass: run `cargo test` and confirm everything is green. Give me a one-line summary of what changed.
